recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If a future publication again misses UsageContext content, investigate the publishing/copy pipeline rather than changing the ActorDefinition or metadata datatype source.
issue_request: FHIR-43467 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I correction for the R6 ballot1 ActorDefinition page: ActorDefinition.useContext used the UsageContext datatype, but the UsageContext definition was not available from the ballot site. The Jira resolution described this as an error copying content to the ballot website rather than a requested model change.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-43467 was found in the relevant ActorDefinition, metadata datatype, or fhir.ini history. ActorDefinition already included ActorDefinition.useContext typed as UsageContext, and UsageContext already mapped into the metadata datatype page family; the application appears to have been publication/build-site correction or verification rather than a source edit.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini keeps both usagecontext=metadatatypes and actordefinition=ActorDefinition active, with both UsageContext and ActorDefinition marked normative. Current source/metadatatypes.html and source/metadatatypes-definitions.html contain UsageContext anchors and generated datatype placeholders, and source/actordefinition/structuredefinition-ActorDefinition.xml defines ActorDefinition.useContext with type UsageContext. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-02-05 record the issue as "The page is not loading correctly" with an 8-0-0 Persuasive vote, matching the Jira resolution. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current source already makes the UsageContext definition available and wires ActorDefinition.useContext to that datatype, so adding or changing source prose would be redundant and could create maintenance drift.

related_jiras.note: An earlier UsageContext metadata page cleanup appeared in git history; it shows prior maintenance in the same datatype page family but does not change the FHIR-43467 no-change decision.
